name: Picture transition
responsibility: Decides how a picture arrives: kept parts fly to their new places, departed ones fade, and a picture a flight arrived at is put up as it is
description: It writes the picture into the surface once per picture: the SVG that stays in the page under the canvas as the hidden semantic layer (picture-transition.ts). It tells the stage how the picture arrives, cut to, carried on from the last or brought in part by part, and how far the cards the two pictures share have moved; the painter does the motion. Flights read the time and their frames from the frame clock. The picture of a model that a flight into a card arrived at is put up as it is, with no entrance.

outgoing.label: the time, frames, and the picture's clock
